title: Fix COM mock not intercepting install.ps1 in CI
paragraphs: GetNewClosure() on the CreateShortcut/Save ScriptMethod blocks broke capture of the test's $state variable when the test script runs via the non--File invocation path GitHub Actions' `shell: powershell` uses (dot-sourcing a wrapper that calls the test script by path). Under that path $state came back null inside the closures, so the mock's internal bookkeeping failed and CreateShortcut threw instead of properly faking WScript.Shell.

Removing GetNewClosure() lets the script blocks resolve $state via normal dynamic scoping instead, which works identically whether the test is run via -File or via GitHub Actions' invocation style. Verified locally with pwsh reproducing both invocation modes. install.ps1's real shortcut-creation behavior is unchanged.
